source_row.component: the iceoryx2 binding (up-rust SEooC), at any revision; no binding revision was assessed by this correction
source_row.detail: Every arrival is owed a report within the declared latency, but a subscriber at iceoryx2 0.9.3 observes only whether any sample is queued and the samples it takes: no fill count, no eviction event, no refused-arrival event (R1 C2). With a queue that stays non-empty and a failed notification, an arrival has no evidence. The binding needs a mechanism that observes every required arrival at the queue or overflow boundary, or the route's claim is limited as qos and the binding's declaration require; no no-false-miss claim may rest on the subset observed. Two cases make the gap concrete: while one publisher's data connection is missing, arrivals of the route's other publishers into a queue that is already non-empty still need their reports; and a sample that was queued at the previous report, together with a later notification (for example of a publisher whose connection is not yet set up), is no evidence, so the binding needs a way to tell a newly queued sample from an old one.
